column1: # THE REAL-FAMILY SPECS' SLICE COSTS (SliceParts): seconds of one warm JVM's single thread per slice, the population
# walk (PopulationMonotonicitySpec.walked) plus ReadSetClosureSpec's checks, measured 2026-11-17 on a laptop. Only
# SliceParts' balance reads them: a slice not listed weighs SliceParts.UnmeasuredSeconds (most walk in 1-3 s), and a
# stale row moves a slice to another part, never out of the check. Refresh when a slice lands that walks for long.
